why: The November 2026 second stage writes a copy of the loader into the startup files of VS Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Discord and GitHub Desktop and marks it with markers that are in strong.txt (Greenflagged, 2026-11-03). A startup file that holds a confirmed indicator runs the payload each time the editor opens, after the repository is cleaned and the package removed, and no check read these files before 3.2 (ADR-0064). The advice is to reinstall the app.

findings.match: VS Code's startup file contains an indicator

must_print: Quit VS Code and install it again
